hero.lede: Original, culture-inspired accessories and gifts — designed in-house, produced through a managed network of 500+ factories across China, never resold from someone else's mold.
hero.imageAlt: Art Deco blue and gold rhinestone resin phone case on a marble table

process.heading: 500+ factories. One studio running them.
process.intro: We don't own a single factory — that's what lets us run the network instead of being limited by it. Every design is placed with whichever specialist in our 500+ factory network across China builds it best, matched by material and process rather than locked into one production line. We own the concept, the sample approval and the inspection; the network builds to our spec.

steps.p: Original concept and artwork, developed in-house around one cultural or aesthetic idea.
A physical sample is produced by our production partner from the approved artwork.
Our own team inspects and signs off on every sample before it goes to bulk.
Bulk manufacturing runs through the right partner in our 500+ factory network, matched to this design's process.
Every order is inspected before it leaves the partner facility.

process.note: We run this way on purpose, not by default: owning zero factories means we're never limited to what one production line can run. A resin-casting specialist builds the phone cases; an electroplating shop handles metal frames; an embroidery house takes on textile pieces — we route each design to whichever factory in the network does that process best, then hold every one of them to the same sample and inspection standard.
